_comment: Which demo acts have been recorded, and by when the unrecorded ones are owed. `docs/governance/demo-script.md` says 'the recordings ARE the deliverable' and `.claude/skills/close-milestone` step 8 says to record at close -- and NO act had ever been recorded. Act 0 belongs to M00b, which closed and tagged four milestones before this file existed. The rule was real, stated in two places, and enforced by nothing, which is this repository's most-repeated defect.
_why_this_is_data_and_not_prose: `brand_tone`'s widening was owed 'to M04' in an ADR, M04 closed without paying it, and nothing noticed. An obligation written only in a sentence is discharged by forgetting. `tests/test_demo_recordings.py` reads this file, so an act that goes unrecorded past the milestone it was deferred to turns the suite RED rather than turning invisible.
_what_recording_is_and_is_not_evidence_f: For Act 2 the EVIDENCE is PR #29 -- permanent, linkable, re-derivable by a stranger, carrying the gate's own posted comment and exit 1 in the workflow log. The claim in the twelve-claims table cites that PR, not a video, and nothing about claim 2's falsifiability depends on a recording. The recording is a PRESENTATION artifact. That is not true of every act -- Act 4's go/no-go artifact is produced BY the run -- so the distinction is recorded per act rather than assumed across all of them.

acts.title: The control
acts.why: M00b closed without it and the debt was invisible until M04 went looking. Deferred to M05 rather than backdated: it records alongside Acts 1 and 2, and the three share a thread -- Act 0's control hands its viewer context, clock and blackout table to ADV-010, and Act 2 is the platform blocking exactly that probe. Together it is an arc; apart it is two clips.
